verdict.rationale: Typesense's docs describe it as a typo-tolerant search engine ([typesense-docs-25], [typesense-docs-40]). Community users confirm it handles typographic errors out of the box and praise its fuzzy matching ([typesense-comm-13], [typesense-comm-12]). Tunability is shown only by a 'Tuning Typo Tolerance' section heading in the ranking guide ([typesense-docs-10]), with no detail on the actual controls. Missing for 10: documented specifics of the tunable typo rules (e.g. typo counts, minimum word length thresholds, per-field or per-query control), and hands-on evidence of tuning working.
